note: Both sets correctly capture the datum elevations (solar envelope 18'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", grade 0'-0"), the 2x4 cedar handrails, 1/8" cable railing, powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, and the 2 x APSE-20 (40 tube) solar thermal array. Set A adds useful facts (A-511 Hardie reference, tilt-and-turn door operation, APSE-20 model, several window tags) but also introduces clear errors: it calls window tag 1.07 a "dimension" and binds PV solar array to a "roof" component, and its PV location (grid lines 4-5) is not supported by its quote. Set B is more disciplined, adding correct claims on cement fibre board siding, the dotted-line door swing convention, and tags D1 1.01 and W5 1.14, with only the unsupported PV grid-line location and a loose "dimension" label for the 18'-0" solar envelope height as defects. Both sets contain redundant repeats, but B has fewer misbound or unsupported claims while covering at least as many distinct facts.
